text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — I pulled together a proposed consolidation of the launch timeline and a hard cutline for MVP vs v1. Exec review is tomorrow at 10am, need alignment today.
Diego (Eng): Can you drop the cutlist? I want to check infra impacts.
Priya (PM): Sure — TL;DR: hold core generation + routing, cut advanced tenant routing (+multitenant analytics) to v1, move SSO v1 to post-MVP pilot, keep embeddings cache + core telemetry for MVP.
Maya (Design): UX scope: basic onboarding + minimal prompt templates stay. The advanced org admin UX moves to v1.
Sam (Eng Lead): Technical constraints: if we cut multitenant analytics, we free up ~2x GPU hours and avoid 1 cross-service dependency. That buys us time for stability tests.
Avery (Product Ops): Risk note — a few customers asked for SSO in pilot. If we delay, we should offer a checklist for privacy reviewers. I can draft a communications snippet.
Diego (Eng): Objection: embeddings cache is helpful to keep latency high and cost low. If we keep that, we need to quantify perf delta. Can we make a scoped MVP version (L1 cache only) instead of full cache?
Priya (PM): Good call. Proposal: MVP keeps L1 prefix/KV cache for hot tenants only, full global cache + cache invalidation becomes v1. That satisfies cost/latency and reduces testing surface for MVP.
Sam (Eng Lead): Agree. We should add a non-blocking telemetry gate: if 95p token latency > 250ms in canary, we rollback to smaller batch sizes. Add rollout plan to avoid customer impact.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary window 2026-03-24T16:00Z -> 2026-03-24T18:00Z (automated note)
Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria for MVP (short):
- Core text gen 95p latency < 250ms on canary
- End-to-end cost/unit estimates within +20% of baseline
- Basic onboarding flows pass UX smoke tests
- No unresolved P0 bugs in serving runtime
Diego (Eng): I'll scope quick perf sprint. ETA for numbers: EOD.
Maya (Design): I'll run UX smoke checklist and mark any must-fix issues.
Avery (Product Ops): I'll prepare exec slide with proposed cutline + customer comms.
Priya (PM): Owners: Diego -> perf numbers, Sam -> rollout playbook + latency fallback, Maya -> UX checklist, Avery -> comms & exec slide.
Sam (Eng Lead): Question on model pinning: do we pin to a smaller, quantized model for MVP to hit latency? That affects quality.
Priya (PM): Not pinning unless perf shows we can't meet SLOs. Prefer config change (batching/kv cache) over changing model. If we must pin, treat it as emergency fallback and notify QA + product.
Diego (Eng): Noted. Will include model-sensitivity matrix in EOD update.
Avery (Product Ops): One more: legal asked for a minimal audit log for Private deployments. Can we include a basic retention flag (off by default) in MVP?
Sam (Eng Lead): We can wire a lightweight event sink in MVP — low-effort and satisfies legal for pilot.
Priya (PM): Ok. Final decision path for today: 1) Keep embeddings L1 cache, 2) Cut multitenant analytics + advanced admin to v1, 3) Defer SSO v1 to post-MVP pilot, 4) Add telemetry rollback policy to rollout. If no major objections by 18:00, I’ll lock cutline and update the exec slide. :white_check_mark:
Diego (Eng): No objections — will post perf numbers by EOD.
Maya (Design): No objections from UX.
Avery (Product Ops): On it. Draft comms in #product-ops when ready. :memo:
Priya (PM): Thanks all — small ask: when you post updates, please include `#cutline-MAR` in message for traceability.
Sam (Eng Lead): Will do.
release-bot: note archived thread for timeline review
Avery (Product Ops): Action items recap: Diego (perf + model matrix), Sam (rollout playbook + audit sink), Maya (UX checklist), Priya (exec slide), Avery (customer comms). Will sync at 17:30 in #product for a last check.
Priya (PM): End of thread — see you at 17:30.
